raw.rationale: This compound is a launched antihypertensive diuretic acting on renal ion transporters (SLC12A1/3, carbonic anhydrases) with no known broad anticancer cytotoxic mechanism, so selective lineage killing at 2.5 µM is unlikely and probabilities should sit near the low base rate. Any apparent selectivity would most plausibly reflect lineage-specific transporter expression (e.g., SLC12A1 in kidney-like/renal lineages) rather than a general cytotoxic effect.
